g.text: GAFF PEO scaling · one NVIDIA GH200
Fixed density · matched PME and cutoff · 100 steps × 3 samples, median · all physics checks passed
GPU: PID-filtered NVML samples every 100 ms, including CUDA context; transient peaks may be missed.
Host: observed engine-process RSS, including C++ / Python front-end; comparison parent excluded. Normal neighbor capacity.
Mixed: FP32 force/FFT, position + residual, FP64 velocity/integration in both engines. Exact common initial geometry.
Points are measurements; connecting lines are guides. Throughput is unmonitored; memory is sampled in separate engine runs.
